name: Serina
source:
Age: self proclaimed 20

A mysterious girl who works part-time as a maid at a maid café in the entertainment district.

She works under the name "Serina" and even refers to herself exclusively as "Serina," using an extremely sweet and affectionate voice.

The café has many regular customers who specifically come to see her. She calls these customers her "Big Brothers" and wins them over through natural-seeming physical contact and affectionate behavior.

She happened to witness Masaharu's marriage proposal at the movie theater, and that encounter becomes the starting point for her approaching him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
